project.title: Hotel booking prototype
project.alt: Verified room comparison for six synthetic guests: full three-night costs and explicit room-quantity recovery
project.desc: Compare full-stay room costs, resolve capacity limits and complete a recoverable demonstration booking.
project.built: Extended the existing Express/static booking journey with full-stay room comparisons and explicit quantity recovery, using the same exact-cent rules that validate the final quotation.
project.why: A nightly price alone hides the cost of a multi-room stay. Guests also need to understand why a room type cannot accommodate their party and how to correct the selection.
how: Choose future dates and guest count. Compare the full stay price for each room type, with its nightly rate, nights and room quantity shown.
Use an explicit minimum-room action to resolve capacity or stock problems; every comparison updates together, while previous quotes and reviews are invalidated.
Choose a room, enter sample details and review the exact same quotation. Existing session recovery and stable confirmation retries remain available.
project.demonstrates: Shared business rules, exact pricing, accessible recovery from invalid selections and consistent state across a multi-step application.
project.caption: Genuine capture of the verified shared interface. The hotel is fictional; photography is illustrative and credited. Browser-only public mode is labelled prominently.
project.result: Rule/API regressions, a disposable MySQL 8.4 catalog check and nine Express/static browser journeys gate publication. A six-guest, three-night example moves explicitly from one invalid double room at EUR360 to three valid rooms at EUR1080; these are synthetic quoted amounts, not bookings or business impact. Tests reconcile every room-card total with the later quote, clear stale downstream state after quantity changes, retain sample guest details, and check keyboard/mobile use alongside the existing confirmation recovery paths.
project.limits: The hotel, rooms, prices and guest records are synthetic. Public Pages runs only the shared browser demonstration; it does not run Express or MySQL. Stock is illustrative per room type, not a date-based hotel inventory or a held allocation. Confirmations create no real reservation, payment, account or message. Review/receipt state is temporary; the bounded Express cache and local session store are educational rather than a production booking database.
project.technical: A shared pure roomOption assessment computes integer-cent totals, capacity, stock eligibility and a bounded minimum-room suggestion. makeQuote delegates to that assessment and retains its original valid quote contract and rejection messages. Both manual and suggested quantity changes clear quote/review/receipt state while retaining dates and sample guest details. The server recalculates from its own catalog. Existing CSRF, 15-minute reviews, bounded token-keyed receipts and explicit stale-review recovery remain in place.
project.run: Run npm ci, npm test and npm start for Express at http://127.0.0.1:3000. No database is needed by default. npm run build:demo generates the public static version. An optional isolated MySQL Docker setup and opt-in integration test are documented separately.
gallery: Full-stay totals at the selected quantity, with specific capacity explanations and explicit repair actions.
The same comparison and quantity recovery on a narrow viewport, with keyboard focus returned to the quantity control.
The selected full-stay amount carried into the review before explicit confirmation.
Existing Express session recovery preserves sample details and requires a fresh explicit confirmation.
project.challenge: Room cards and final quotation previously had separate eligibility calculations, and changing quantity could leave an older review reachable. One shared assessment now drives comparison and authoritative validation; one quantity-change boundary invalidates all downstream state. An invalid current quantity can show a clearly labelled price without enabling booking, and a repair is offered only when the required quantity fits example stock.
